install.notes: backend/pyproject.toml requires Python >=3.12 (line 5), and the runtime dependencies include numpy>=1.26, pyvisa>=1.14 and pyvisa-py>=0.7 (lines 19-25). scripts/setup.ps1:55 installs the backend with pip install -e backend[extras]; the optional hw extra adds psutil, pyusb, libusb-package, pyserial and zeroconf (pyproject.toml:30-38). Only native.py imports ece_suite, inside the hardware factory; the gate never installs or imports the upstream package.
